title: Status assertion cannot distinguish missing file from content
root_cause: The test reports only that ready? returned false. The hidden path could refer to a missing or inaccessible file, or the file could be readable with content that the code rejects; the evidence does not distinguish these causes.

relevant_evidence.why: The assertion gives no underlying file or content detail.
A failed read and a nonmatching value both return false.
The test asserts the combined result using the runtime path.
The path comes from a masked secret.
